snippet.title: The Traveller's Sight - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Whishlist now !
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356000/The_Travellers_Sight/

The Traveller's Sight is a fully-filmed investigation video game. Its fantastic film noir aesthetic will transport you into an extraordinary adventure. 

 Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer. 

Coming soon in 2026
